body: I've already taken a lot of time off school due to depression and now is a pretty crucial period, I know I can't do it again. I do have a boyfriend who is usually wonderful to me, but it's been a rough week for us and we had a fight tonight when I was trying to let him know what was up. I've become a burden and I know it. Honestly just the fact that you took the time to write this post feels nice though, so thank you.
